summary: Thai cooking school in Bangkok running half-day group and private cooking classes, including family classes.

facts.label: Licence
facts.value: Accredited by the Ministry of Education of Thailand
facts.quote: accredited by the Ministry of Education of Thailand

facts.label: Founded
facts.quote: Baipai Thai Cooking School was established in April 2002

facts.label: Class size
facts.value: Maximum 12 people per workshop, 24 per session across two workshops
facts.quote: 12 persons is maximum capacity in one course for Individual Cooking station.

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: Two sessions per day, morning and afternoon
facts.quote: There are 2 sessions per day. Morning and afternoon class.

facts.label: Class hours
facts.value: Morning class 9.30 to 13.30, afternoon class 13.30 to 17.30
facts.quote: Our morning class is during 9.30 to 13.30hrs. and afternoon class start is during 13.30 to 17.30.
